name: Brand Awareness Video Framework
description: A framework for creating brand awareness videos by generating user personas, content spaces, tonality, and scripts.
prompt_base: You are the best marketer on Earth specifically specialising in video storytelling that helps brands get reach on social media. You are weird like Vsauce, thorough like Veritasium, goofy and imaginative like Tim Urban, and can write copy like David Ogilvy. You do this by understanding what kind of content the brands want by taking them through a series of steps mentioned below, providing them a few options at each step, and then on the basis of the user's reply, proceeding to the next step. Your scripts are written in such a way to have some stimulation every 3-5 seconds.

steps.name: Link
steps.description: Collect initial inputs like the brand name and website link

prompts.prefix: Based on the brand website, do a thorough research on who the user could be. Total length for each user persona should not be more than 100 words. Try to create the persona of a person, give them a name, demographics, psychographics and other details and tell us what content do they like? The content that they like should not be connected to the brand or the category- they need to be based on the kind of youtube channels, movies & OTT shows that are this persona’s favorites. Also tell me the relative size of each persona with respect to other.

options: Option 1: Liam Nguyen, 32, male, lives in San Francisco, CA. He’s a marketing manager earning $80K/year, single, renting a chic apartment. Liam craves quality, minimalism, and authenticity, loving curated experiences like craft coffee and vinyl records. Witty and curious, he rejects flashy logos, seeking style at value prices. His digital life buzzes on Instagram, curating his aesthetic. He researches purchases meticulously, prioritizing atelier-grade essentials. Stimulus Alert: Liam sips espresso, watching Vsauce unravel reality, planning a sleek dinner party. Content Preferences: Loves Vsauce (YouTube), Inception (movie), Succession (OTT show). Relative Audience Size: 3X (urban professionals, 35-40% of Italic’s market).

Option 2: Sofia Martinez, 27, female, resides in Brooklyn, NY. A freelance writer earning $65K/year, she’s single, sharing a loft. Sofia values understated elegance, creativity, and independence, frequenting art galleries and indie bookstores. Introspective yet stylish, she avoids ostentatious brands, craving luxury without markup. Her Pinterest is a mood-board masterpiece. Stimulus Alert: Sofia journals in a café, Vox’s quirky explainer sparking her next essay. She’s discerning, seeking unique, logo-free pieces that tell a story. Content Preferences: Loves Vox (YouTube), Amélie (movie), Fleabag (OTT show). Relative Audience Size: 2X (young creatives, 25-30% of Italic’s market).

Option 3: Ethan Patel, 40, male, lives in Chicago, IL. A tech consultant earning $120K/year, he’s married, owning a condo. Ethan prioritizes efficiency, quality, and practicality, enjoying podcasts and city runs. Analytical and confident, he dislikes wasteful spending, seeking durable, logo-free essentials. His LinkedIn is sharp, reflecting his professional edge. Stimulus Alert: Ethan jogs, Wendover’s logistics video fueling his next client pitch. He values function over flash, choosing Italic for timeless utility. Content Preferences: Loves Wendover Productions (YouTube), The Social Network (movie), The Morning Show (OTT show). Relative Audience Size: X (older professionals, 15-20% of Italic’s market).

Option 1: Priya Sharma, 34, female, lives in Bengaluru, India. A school teacher earning ₹8L/year, she’s married with a toddler. Priya champions sustainability, safety, and community, using non-toxic products for her family. She loves urban gardening and mommy blogs, distrusting chemical-heavy brands. Active on Instagram, she shares eco-tips. Stimulus Alert: Priya’s mixing a Born Good detergent, watching Kurzgesagt explain ocean cleanup, planning a green playdate. Content Preferences: Loves Kurzgesagt (YouTube), Zootopia (movie), Made in Heaven (OTT show). Relative Audience Size: 3X (urban parents, 40-45% of Born Good’s market, prioritizing safe, eco-friendly homes).

Option 2: Arjun Menon, 28, male, resides in Mumbai, India. A startup founder earning ₹12L/year, he’s single, renting a modern flat. Arjun values innovation, sustainability, and efficiency, experimenting with zero-waste hacks. He’s skeptical of greenwashing, active on LinkedIn. Stimulus Alert: Arjun’s testing Born Good’s dish liquid, Vox’s recycling video sparking a pitch idea. He seeks planet-friendly solutions with style. Content Preferences: Loves Vox (YouTube), The Martian (movie), The Great Indian Kapil Show (OTT show). Relative Audience Size: 2X (young professionals, 25-30% of Born Good’s market, drawn to eco-tech).

Option 3: Lakshmi Iyer, 55, female, lives in Chennai, India. A retired bank manager earning ₹6L/year pension, she’s widowed, living with family. Lakshmi prioritizes health, tradition, and eco-conscious living, using natural cleaners. She enjoys community events, distrusts harsh chemicals. Stimulus Alert: Lakshmi’s washing linens with Born Good, Tasty’s recipe video inspiring dinner. Content Preferences: Loves Tasty (YouTube), Lagaan (movie), Panchayat (OTT show). Relative Audience Size: X (older eco-conscious, 15-20% of Born Good’s market, valuing safety, tradition).

steps.name: Select User Persona
steps.description: User selects a user persona from the options

prompts.prefix: What are the content spaces? These are the wide spaces that our brand would like to tell stories about. Remember these are not scripts, but spaces from which 50 scripts can come.The spaces do not have to be salesy at all. They do not have to be directly connected to the brand or the category. They might be about things that this brand might want to talk about, be about. It is the world view of the brand. They have to be spaces that might catch the attention of the user and things that they’d like to watch all by themselves

options: Option 1: Art of the less: Stories about finding beauty and meaning in simplicity—decluttering spaces, minds, or lives. Think a minimalist apartment tour with a single, striking piece of art (3-sec hook: a sleek shelf with one book). Or a profile of a chef who crafts a perfect dish with three ingredients (5-sec twist: it’s a recipe Liam can try tonight). Videos explore how less sparks creativity, focus, or joy, echoing Liam’s love for curated aesthetics and Inception’s layered simplicity. These resonate with his Pinterest-worthy lifestyle without screaming “buy this.”

Option 2: Urban whimsey: Quirky, unexpected moments in city life—street musicians, secret rooftop gardens, or pop-up art. Imagine a video on a barista doodling portraits on coffee cups (3-sec hook: latte art morphs into a face). Or a time-lapse of a mural appearing overnight (5-sec twist: it’s by an anonymous artist). Liam’s Inception-like love for layered surprises and Vsauce’s playful curiosity make these urban vignettes click. They reflect Italic’s understated elegance, grabbing Liam’s attention on TikTok.”

Option 3: A Quiet Rebellion: Profiles of people who defy norms subtly—quitting corporate for a micro-business or living off-grid in style. Think a coder building an app for niche hobbyists (3-sec hook: it’s for vinyl collectors!). Or a teacher turning a classroom into a philosophy club (5-sec twist: kids debate like Succession tycoons). Liam’s anti-logo stance and love for Inception’s subversive depth make these compelling. These Reels-worthy tales vibe with Italic’s bold yet understated identity, hooking Liam solo.

Option 1: Everyday Eco wins: Stories celebrating small, sustainable actions by ordinary people—composting, upcycling, or seed-saving. Picture a mom crafting toys from scrap fabric (3-sec hook: a kid hugs a handmade doll). Or a neighbor swapping veggie seeds (5-sec twist: it grows a rare heirloom!). Priya’s Kurzgesagt-fueled curiosity loves practical green tips. These Reels vibe with her eco-mom life, mirroring Born Good’s planet-first mission, grabbing her attention solo without a sales pitch.

Option 2: Tales of creating nurturing, toxin-free environments—homes, schools, or parks. Imagine a classroom turned chemical-free art hub (3-sec hook: kids paint with natural dyes). Or a family’s plastic-free kitchen (5-sec fact: it’s all bamboo!). Priya’s Zootopia-like passion for safe communities connects here. These Instagram Stories reflect Born Good’s non-toxic ethos, with emotional hooks that make Priya pause her scroll and watch alone.

Option 3: Explorations of nature’s lessons for human life—how plants or animals inspire harmony. Think a video on mangroves shielding coasts (3-sec hook: roots sway in waves). Or bees teaching community (5-sec twist: a kid mimics their teamwork!). Priya’s Made in Heaven love for emotional depth and Kurzgesagt’s big-picture thinking shine. These YouTube Shorts echo Born Good’s plant-based roots, captivating Priya with awe-inspiring visuals she’d savor by herself.

steps.name: Select Content Spaces
steps.description: User selects a content space from the options

prompts.prefix: Write the instagram organic content scripts for the ideas shortlisted. Each script can be between 15 to 20 seconds long. Don’t make the script salsey. The main point is to capture attention, get the user to reach the end of the video and remember/feel something strongly about the brand's world view.

options:
Script 1: Visuals/Editing: Upbeat lo-fi beat, quick cuts, text overlays in bold sans-serif.
Script: [0-3 sec] Close-up: A hand twists a plastic bottle, LED flickers on. “Meet Ravi, who turns trash into light!”
[4-7 sec] Montage: Ravi cuts bottles, wires LEDs, tests a glowing lamp. “Old bottles? He makes solar lamps for street vendors.”
[8-12 sec] Wide shot: Vendor’s stall glows at night. “One hack lights up lives.”
[13-18 sec] Text overlay: ‘Small ideas, big impact.’ Cut to Ravi grinning, lamp in hand. “What’s your eco-hack?”

Script 2: Visuals/Editing: Bright acoustic track, smooth zooms, vibrant colors, text pops.
Script: [0-3 sec] Drone shot: Lush balcony garden in Mumbai. “Anita’s balcony? It’s a farm!”
[4-8 sec] Clips: Anita waters herbs, picks tomatoes, composts scraps. “She grows 10 crops in 50 square feet.”
[9-13 sec] Close-up: Tomato sliced for salad. “Zero-waste, homegrown meals? Yes!”
[14-20 sec] Text overlay: ‘Live light, grow bold.’ Anita smiles, holding a basil sprig. “What’s your future-proof move?”

Script 3: Visuals/Editing: Energetic synth beat, fast cuts, neon text overlays in futuristic font.
Script:
[0-3 sec] Close-up: A circuit board sparks, LED glows. “Nisha’s turning e-waste into tech!”
[4-7 sec] Montage: Nisha solders old phone parts, tests a glowing speaker. “Broken chargers? She builds Bluetooth speakers!”
[8-12 sec] Wide shot: Speaker pulses at a night market. “One fix, less landfill.”
[13-17 sec] Text overlay: ‘Hack the planet.’ Nisha grins, holding her creation. “What’s your eco-fix?”

Script 1: Visuals/Editing: Smooth jazz track, slow pans, minimalist white text overlays in sleek font.
Script:
[0-3 sec] Pan: A single wooden chair in a sunlit room. “Amit’s home? One chair.”
[4-7 sec] Clips: Amit sips coffee, reads, naps on that chair. “No clutter, just moments.”
[8-12 sec] Close-up: Chair’s polished grain glows. “One piece, endless stories.”
[13-18 sec] Text overlay: ‘Less is enough.’ Amit smiles, sunlight hits chair. “What’s your one thing?”

Script 2: Visuals/Editing: Lo-fi beat, quick cuts, bold text pops in neutral tones.
Script:
[0-3 sec] Zoom: Fingers strum three guitar notes. “Rhea’s song? Three notes.”
[4-7 sec] Montage: Rhea plays on a rooftop, crowd sways. “Minimal chords, maximum soul.”
[8-11 sec] Close-up: Her fingers dance on strings. “Less noise, more heart.”
[12-16 sec] Text overlay: ‘Simplify to shine.’ Rhea winks, strumming softly. “What’s your simple spark?”

Script 3: Visuals/Editing: Upbeat indie guitar track, quick cuts, vibrant text overlays in handwritten font.
Script:
[0-3 sec] Zoom: A violinist plays on a busy SF sidewalk. “Nila’s music stops the city!”
[4-7 sec] Montage: Commuters pause, a kid dances, phones film. “One bow, a street’s spellbound.”
[8-12 sec] Close-up: Violin strings hum, her smile glows. “Magic in the everyday.”
[13-17 sec] Text overlay: ‘Find the spark.’ Nila bows, crowd claps. “What’s your city magic?”

steps.name: Select Script
steps.description: User selects a script from the options

steps.name: Image Prompts
steps.description: Generate images' prompts for each scene in the script

prompts.prefix: Now, generate description for each visual scene in the following script. Imagine you're the director and the video playing in your head. What do you see in each scene in that video with utmost detail while adhering to the essense of the overall script.

options: Scene 1 (Hook): A dazling iPhone with Apple logo talking to it's person
Scene 2: Owner looks impressed, nodding in agreement with the iPhone's statement.
Scene 3: Zoom out, the person is an AI itself.

prompts.output_instruction: Add `||` between each scene. Do not output anything else.

steps.name: Voiceover Prompt
steps.description: Generate prompt to synthesize the speech of the video.

prompts.prefix: Now, generate speech for the given script. Imagine you're the voiceover artist and the video playing in your head. Write down what do you speak?

options: Stuck in a creative rut? What if your tools fueled your imagination instead of hindering it? Imagine: Instant access to millions of colors at your fingertips. Effortless collaboration, sharing ideas instantly across the globe. The power of a full studio, right in your backpack. From rough sketches to polished masterpieces, all powered by Apple. Unlock your potential. Unleash your vision. Apple. Powering your creativity.

prompts.output_instruction: Just output the speech text. Do not output anything else.

steps.name: Background Music Prompt
steps.description: Generate prompt to synthesize the music of the video.

prompts.prefix: Now, create a text prompt that will be fed to another LLM to generate music for a Brand Awareness Video with the following aspects:

options: Create upbeat, curious music with clean electronic and warm acoustic elements. Playful rhythm, surprising moments. Think tech discovery excitement with a wink.

prompts.output_instruction: The prompt should be less than 200 characters. Just output the text. Do not output anything else.

steps.name: Background Music
steps.description: Generate background music for the video

steps.name: Final Video
steps.description: Create video by combining images, voiceover, and background music
